title: P246E - P246E
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  EGT sensor and wiring.

Note, Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: RoW B8 chassis A4 (8K) models with Engine code CAGA which uses the UDS protocol:
The Advanced Measuring Values for EGT sensors may not be labeled correctly!  Make sure to Kontrol edin: [*ENG106430*] Exhaust gas temperature before particulate filter even though this is the last (4th) sensor.
Unplugging the suspect EGT sensor while re-checking the resulting fault codes and evaluating Advanced Measuring Values would be advised before replacing parts.
